name: contexel
description: Give your coding agent your team's shared memory, alongside its own. Bundles a skill (retrieve team context first; save the decisions, standards, and lessons the user asks to keep into Contexel), a light session-start reminder, and two memory hooks that make a "remember this" reach Contexel too. Complements the Contexel MCP connection and the per-project rules file; it does not replace them.
